name: 10. Asymmetric ACK Drop & Retry Handling
description: SOS packet successfully reaches Rescue Hub 0, but the returning ACK from Hub is dropped along the reverse path. Validates that wristband retries until receiving valid ACK.
expected_behavior: Hub receives SOS and registers alert, but Survivor 1 receives no ACK and triggers retry. Hub recognizes duplicate SOS and suppresses duplicate rescue ticket.
